newsitem.title: UK: Pace Micro shares fall as sentiment turns.
newsitem.headline: Pace Micro shares fall as sentiment turns.

text.p: Shares in Pace Micro Technology Plc were among the day's biggest losers on Friday as sentiment was hit by the announcement that BSkyB's talks with Germany's Kirch Gruppe had collapsed. The shares fell over 10 percent or 11p to 98-1/2p by 1228 GMT. Pace is widely tipped to be a leading supplier of decoders for BSkyB's digital satellite television service but BSkyB's failure to set up a German satellite television service with Kirch caused the share-price to weaken.

"Sentiment has been disturbed," said one trader. "People were hoping that BSkyB would announce the decoder order this week, and the news that the German partnership talks have ended could mean demand for the decoders will not be as high."
